name: j-cc
description: Harness tuning for Claude models in Claude Code: dedicated-tool routing, deterministic shell guards, background long-running commands. No external model or API key.

modelJudge.title: Model judge for ambiguous commands
modelJudge.description: Ask a small model inside Claude Code (no API key) whether a script or loop the rules cannot decide will wait, run endlessly, or take minutes.

blockChaining.title: Block command chaining
blockChaining.description: Block Bash, PowerShell and exec commands that chain with &&, || or ; outside quotes, so each command runs in its own call. Off by default: splitting harmless chains costs extra round trips.
